title: Walt Disney Cartoon Classics Volume 13: Donald's Scary Tales
original_title: Walt Disney Cartoon Classics Volume 13: Donald's Scary Tales
overview: Donald's Scary Tales is a compilation of Walt Disney Halloween-themed animated shorts featuring Donald Duck and Pluto, including Donald Duck and the Gorilla, Duck Pimples, Donald's Lucky Day, Pluto's Judgement Day, Lonesome Ghosts and Trick or Treat.
